exposure: high-intensity pain during the postpartum stay
prepregnancy vulnerability factors (young age, high body mass index, and African-born migrant)
immediate skin-to-skin contact with their newborn
bad memories of delivery on day 2 postpartum
finding: Approximately 1 in 11 women with cesarean deliveries had posttraumatic stress disorder symptoms at 2 months postpartum, with several prepregnancy, obstetrical, and delivery-related factors influencing this risk.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery after induced labor and postpartum hemorrhage were associated with a higher risk of posttraumatic stress disorder symptoms at 2 months postpartum.
